d7Notify.intro: Choose what reaches you, and where. Changes save as you make them.
d7Notify.grid.title: How you hear from us
d7Notify.grid.intro: A dash means we don't send that one there. Locked rows always reach your inbox.
d7Notify.row.go_live: A channel you follow goes live
d7Notify.row.go_live.hint: Your default for every channel. Each channel's bell and its own choices are below.
d7Notify.row.payout.hint: When a payout is sent or changes.
d7Notify.row.creator: Your videos
d7Notify.row.creator.hint: When a broadcast of yours is saved as a video.
d7Notify.row.digest_weekly.hint: New videos and clips from channels you follow, and open co-op votes. Sent on Mondays, only when there is something new.
d7Notify.always.moderation: Decisions about your account or content
d7Notify.always.moderation.why: The law requires us to tell you about moderation decisions and how to appeal.
d7Notify.always.system.why: These keep your account safe, like a stream key that may have leaked.
d7Notify.always.export.why: You asked for it, so we always tell you when it's ready.
d7Notify.always.membership.why: Your membership is your share in the co-op, so you always hear when it changes.
d7Notify.always.reports.why: When you report something, we always tell you what was decided.
d7Notify.always.moderator.why: You always hear when a channel gives you a role.
d7Notify.digest.consent: Off until you turn it on. You can stop it from any digest email.
d7Notify.channels.following: See everyone you follow on the Following page
d7Notify.inbox.title: Inbox
d7Notify.inbox.intro: Everything we've told you, newest first.
d7Notify.inbox.emptyBody: Go-live alerts, votes and payouts show up here.
d7Notify.inbox.emptyFilteredBody: Try another filter, or show all.
d7Notify.inbox.loadMoreFailed: More notifications didn't load. Try again.
d7Notify.item.reportActionTaken: A report you made was reviewed: action taken
d7Notify.item.reportNoAction: A report you made was reviewed: no action
d7Notify.locked.payoutInApp: Payouts are financial records, so they always stay in your inbox and on your revenue page.
